sections.title: EMPA Capstone II
sections.description: Successful completion of a Capstone project is one of the academic requirements for the Executive Master of Public Administration (MPA) at the University of Pennsylvanias Fels Institute of Government. This core course is designed to give students direct guidance as they apply and consolidate knowledge and skills gained across the curriculum through the completion of a rigorous Capstone project. Capstone students are responsible for designing and completing a public policy or public administration-related project and presenting a deliverable to the Fels community and other stakeholders.
